Minutes of a Called Meeting of the City Council

Austin Texas July 01, 1892

Hon John Mc Donald Mayor presiding
Roll Call
Roll Call
Present - Aldermen Anderson, Assmann, Grass, Jackson, Linn, Miller, Norton, Schuber,
Shelley, - 9

Absent Aldermen, Gresham, Nunn, Hetchum, Morris, Nitschke, North, Platt, Schneider, Sulor,
Townsend, Warmoth, Weyerman, ziller, - 13
The following was read

Mayor's Office
Austin Texas July 1, 1892
To the Members of the Board of Aldermen of the City of Austin Texas Gentlemen, I hereby
call a special meeting of the City Council to assemble in the city hall this day at 3
oclock P.M. for the purpose of taking suitable action on the death of Col. J. W. Robertson
ex Mayor of the city of Austin John McDonald
Mayor

The above call has been served this day by reading it to all the aldermen in the city
A. Montgomery
Sergeant Police

Officers return
of call of council
Alderman Linn moved that a special committee of five be appointed to draft suitable
resolutions on the death of ex Mayor J. W. Robertson The motion prevailed and the chair
appointed Aldermen Linn Miller Anderson Schuber and Platt Council adjourned
The Council then adjourned
Milton Morris,
City Clerk
